id.instruksi: Internet sedang putus, tetapi router Wi-Fi rumah masih menyala dan Bluetooth bisa dipakai. Seret tiap kegiatan: cukup jaringan rumah, butuh internet, atau tidak butuh jaringan?
id.i1: mencetak tugas ke printer lewat Wi-Fi rumah
id.i2: mengirim foto ke HP adik lewat Bluetooth
id.i3: memutar lagu dari HP ke speaker Bluetooth
id.i4: memindahkan berkas ke laptop kakak lewat Wi-Fi rumah
id.i5: mengetik di tablet dengan keyboard Bluetooth
id.i6: main game berdua lewat Bluetooth dengan HP di sebelahmu
id.i7: panggilan video dengan nenek di kota lain
id.i17: mendengar lagu yang sudah diunduh dari speaker HP
id.i18: main game luring yang sudah terpasang

en.instruksi: The internet is down, but the home Wi-Fi router is still on and Bluetooth works. Drag each activity: home network is enough, needs the internet, or needs no network?
en.bin-lokal: home Wi-Fi or Bluetooth is enough
en.i1: printing homework to the printer over home Wi-Fi
en.i2: sending a photo to your sibling's phone by Bluetooth
en.i3: playing a song from the phone on a Bluetooth speaker
en.i4: moving a file to your brother's laptop over home Wi-Fi
en.i5: typing on a tablet with a Bluetooth keyboard
en.i6: playing a two-player game by Bluetooth with the phone next to you
en.i7: a video call with grandma in another city
en.i11: opening an online map for directions
en.i12: uploading homework to an online class
en.i13: taking a photo with the phone camera
en.i17: listening to a downloaded song on the phone speaker

binCount.keterangan: tetap 3 kotak supaya sesuai instruksi (2 kotak tidak dipakai)
